messages:
anna_pm: Quick sync — proposal for an 'autoretire' pipeline: when a model's benchmark delta > 6% over a 14-day rolling window, kick off a tenant-level dry-run + comms flow and queue it for retirement. Dry-run = route a configurable % of requests to candidate variant without billing impact. Want to include migration credits and a 30d opt-out window. Thoughts?
ryan_eng: high level sounds good. questions: how do we compute "benchmark delta" (per-tenant or global)? and who owns the dry-run orchestration?
kevin_csm: prefer tenant-level deltas for large customers, global for long-tail. for commercial customers we need explicit opt-in vs auto-dry-run. migration credits = +1 month free or token credit? needs to be productized.
maria_sre: need clear rollback SLOs for dry-run and canary. if dry-run causes errors we must failover instantly. also need observability hooks (per-tenant evals, request traces, error budgets).
ryan_eng: implementation sketch: autoretire service evaluates metrics daily, emits signal {tenant, model, delta, baseline_ts}. If delta > threshold -> create MigrationPlan with steps: 1) dry-run (X% traffic) for 7d, 2) canary roll for 24h, 3) finalize retire. Dry-run will use routing layer feature flags so cost is zeroed out for affected tenants. Pseudocode:```json
{"trigger":{"scope":"tenant","metric":"bench_delta","window_d":14,"threshold":0.06},"dry_run":{"pct":0.05,"duration_d":7,"billing":"credit_zero"},"canary":{"pct":0.2,"duration_h":24}}```
anna_pm: looks good. need product gates: A) CS approval for enterprise tenants, B) auto for self-serve unless they opt-out in account settings, C) safety net: manual hold for contracts. Also need comm cadence: initial notice + 14d reminder + final 7d before final retire.
kevin_csm: agree. for enterprise, require an in-console 'migration plan' review sign-off. migration credits: smaller tenants get token credit; enterprise get account credit to offset migration risk. ops should track uptake per cohort.
maria_sre: runbook additions: - immediate rollback API (one-liner) - alert to eng-oncall if error rate > 2x baseline in dry-run - automated revert if latency P95 increases > 30% for 1h. Add tracing tag "autoretire.dryrun" for all routed requests.
ryan_eng: dev tasks I see: 1) autoretire evaluator (cron), 2) routing flag + billing shim, 3) UI for migration plan + opt-out toggle, 4) runbook + alerts. estimate 3 sprints for MVP if we parallelize.
anna_pm: prioritization ask: this is Q2 candidate for reducing long-tail tech debt and lowering maintenance for deprecated backends. propose we carve a canary cohort of 100 tenants to test in May. Need a short PRD. I'll draft and tag owners.
kevin_csm: schedule CS readiness session next week. pls include messaging templates (email, in-console modal) and escalation path.
deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly canary slot opens 2024-05-06T09:00Z — reserve if you want to lock cohort.
anna_pm: thanks — I'll circulate PRD by EOD Friday and add owners. if no objections, we lock thresholds at 6%/14d for the first pass. :thumbsup:
ryan_eng: :+1: will proto the evaluator and share APIs.
kevin_csm: :shipit: will prep comms templates.
maria_sre: adding runbook draft to eng-oncall channel after PRD.
anna_pm: closing thread — action items in PRD.
